observations.source: That is always a good attitude. Trying always something different and positive. About the beard I might have it for a few months and then shave it off.
observations.observed_context: Duration: keeping a beard for a few months; not naming a calendar month.

primary_verification.finding: NINJAL distinguishes 月/つき as a calendar-month noun and a restricted counter series such as hitotsuki/futatsuki; general counted month durations normally use kagetsu.
Japan Foundation teaches elapsed duration with ～か月; its three-month example is san-kagetsu.
Japan Foundation distinguishes one-month duration ikka-getsu and number-of-months nan-ka-getsu.

native_diagnostic_limit: Isolated 月→ツキ confirms a reading of that written noun only; it does not qualify the appropriate duration-counter form in this source context.
decision: Withhold months from the initial native candidate. Retain the frozen minor-form judgment and original scores; the lexeme itself is not rejected. A future duration unit requires its own correctly scoped target form and evidence.
